required.name: APEX_PRIVATE_READ_TOKEN
required.purpose: Ephemeral checkout and inventory of catalog-approved private workload repositories
minimum_permissions: Contents: read and metadata read on approved workload repositories
required.exposure: Trusted checkout and Master Strand inventory steps only; never workload environment

required.name: APEX_CONTROL_TOKEN
required.purpose: Read private approvals, inspect private control-plane invariants, and create immutable result receipts
minimum_permissions: Contents: read and write on GlacierEQ/llm-runner-teams
required.exposure: Dedicated control-plane guard, approval, replay, and publish steps only

required.name: APEX_BRANCH_WRITE_TOKEN
required.purpose: Delete only approval-gated nondefault branch refs after the Master Strand extinction gate proves no unique unintegrated progress remains
minimum_permissions: Metadata: read and Contents: read/write on explicitly selected GlacierEQ repositories
required.exposure: Trusted Master Strand extinction adapter only; never checkout, workload process, public output, or persisted logs

runtime.GITHUB_TOKEN: Public bootstrap repository only; contents read and issues write
